cases.name: handler-order
cases.description: calls handler for each enqueued item in order

cases.name: drain-empty-immediate
cases.description: drain resolves immediately on an empty queue

cases.name: missing-handler
cases.description: create rejects a missing handler at the factory boundary

expected.message: BusQueue.create(options): options.handler must be a function

cases.name: size-before-drain
cases.description: size reflects queue depth before drain

cases.name: drain-empties
cases.description: drain resolves when queue empties

cases.name: on-error-continues
cases.description: onError is called when handler throws, delivery continues

cases.name: async-on-error-swallowed
cases.description: an async-rejecting onError callback is swallowed before onHandlerError and queue progress continues

cases.name: abort-signal-cancels
cases.description: AbortSignal cancels queue: enqueue becomes no-op after abort

cases.name: abort-initially-cancelled
cases.description: an already-aborted signal cancels queue admission immediately

cases.name: abort-releases-pending
cases.description: abort releases an item waiting on its admission hook without delivery

cases.name: abort-releases-drain-waiter
cases.description: abort resolves a pending drain waiter after active work is cancelled

cases.name: on-drop-noop
cases.description: drop path remains safe when the queue is already cancelled

cases.name: high-water-mark-validation
cases.description: highWaterMark validation rejects invalid inputs

expected.message: highWaterMark must be a positive integer

cases.name: on-enqueue-hook
cases.description: onEnqueue hook fires with correct depth when item is added

cases.name: throwing-dequeue-hook
cases.description: a throwing dequeue hook does not interrupt current or later queue work

cases.name: rejecting-enqueue-hook
cases.description: a rejecting enqueue hook cancels only its duplicate item and concurrent enqueue recovers

cases.name: admission-hook-on-hook-error
cases.description: a throwing admission hook is routed through onHookError and its item is not delivered

cases.name: rejecting-overflow-hook
cases.description: a rejecting overflow hook cancels only its item and later overflow work progresses

cases.name: single-drain-loop
cases.description: two synchronous enqueue calls in the same tick do not spawn concurrent drain loops

cases.name: fifo-order
cases.description: FIFO order is preserved end-to-end after the CircularBuffer swap, across many enqueues

cases.name: overflow-hook-fires
cases.description: onOverflow hook fires when queue reaches highWaterMark

cases.name: admission-and-overflow-order
cases.description: waits for onEnqueue and onOverflow completion before delivering the item

cases.name: handler-error-hook
cases.description: onHandlerError hook fires when handler throws
